title: Encyclopaedia Britannica - Seventh edition, Volume 13, LAB-Magnetism - EB.15
text: Like many cities, the early history of this is lost in the obscurity of remote ages. The first notice of its existence to which implied credit can be given is that in the Annual of Tactics (ib. iv) who says, "Londumine copamento quidem colatino non insigns, sed copá negotiatorma et cummettman maxime celebre?" The derivation of the name of this city has been variously travels and though it must remain a matter of doubt, we state that which seems the mean probable.
